summary: Expose the live-verified remove-list-settings operation as an explicit, apply-gated clear command.
reason: A disposable list settings probe showed remove-list-settings returns HTTP 200 and a fresh user-data read confirms the settings record is absent. Guessed save/update/set handlers returned HTTP 200 without persistence, so general settings writes remain unsupported and are not enabled.
validated_outcome: Focused tests passed. A disposable list was cleared with --apply, fresh read-back verified the settings record absent, local cache synchronization completed, and the disposable list was deleted. No production data was changed.
